messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — I'm OOO next week (Mon-Thu). Need someone to cover docs PR reviews for SDK snippets + the Go migration guide. Who can pick this up? :wave:
kevin: I can take SDK snippets Mon-Wed. Happy to review short examples and link fixes. :thumbsup:
maria: I can cover the migration guide Thu-Fri and do a pass on the examples. How many PRs are we talking?
sam: I can help with CI/docs preview runs and merges. Any known failing previews I should look at?
alyssa: Thanks! Roughly: 4 small SDK snippet fixes, 1 link-fix batch, 1 migration guide PR, and 1 bigger PR #3245 that's failing the docs-preview.
jen: Quick Q — can we swap review rotation weeks so kevin handles the SDK slot this week? @kevin @maria if that's okay we avoid dropped coverage.
kevin: Swap works for me. FYI PR #3245's preview is failing during mkdocs build with an error on the sidebar link. Error: `ValueError: duplicate label 'Overview'` — might be a toc duplication from the migration guide.
docs-bot: docs-preview failure for PR #3245: https://ci.redwood/internal/3245 — `mkdocs build` exit code 1. Requested: re-run after patch.
sam: I'll re-run the preview and take the first pass on the link fix. If it's the sidebar dup we can grep for duplicate nav entries. Running `grep -R "- Overview" docs/` locally then `mkdocs build` after patch.
maria: If you need context, the migration guide added a top-level "Overview" heading that collides with /docs/overview.md. I can submit a small change to rename it to "Migration overview" and update internal links.
kevin: I'll update CODEOWNERS so that /docs/sdk/ points to @kevin for faster reviewer assignment on snippets. Will open a tiny PR for that now.
jen: Also can we add a tiny reviewer checklist in the PR template: run `mkdocs build`, click the preview link, sanity-check code blocks compile. Saves a roundtrip.
alyssa: Love that. Please add the checklist to `.github/pull_request_template.md` and tag it `docs: PR template`.
sam: Preview re-run succeeded after maria's rename patch. CI link: https://ci.redwood/internal/3245/preview — looks good. I'll schedule small docs merges during Friday 10:00-11:00 PT merge window to avoid stepping on feature deploys.
kevin: CODEOWNERS update PR created: #3301. Added @kevin for /docs/sdk and left /docs/migrations to @maria. Also added label automation for `docs-review`.
maria: Thanks — I'll pick up the migration guide review during my Thu slot and leave comments inline for snippet examples that need code fence fixes.
jen: Checklist added to PR template and included inline reminder to run `mkdocs build`.
alyssa: Fantastic. Summary: kevin covers SDK snippets Mon-Wed, maria handles migration guide Thu-Fri, sam handles previews + Friday merge window 10-11 PT, jen updated template, kevin opened CODEOWNERS PR. I'll update calendar and ping rotation channel. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
kevin: Ack. I'll monitor the `docs-review` label and merge small fixes during the window.
sam: I'll post a short note in #release-war-room before the merge window starts.
alyssa: Done — calendar invite sent to reviewers. Enjoy your weekend prep!
